bsp: NXP i.MX Distro with Wayland and XWayland 6.18-wrynose
warmup: One all-zero dummy inference at model Open, excluded
scope: Inference only, excluding loading, preprocessing, NMS and rendering

accuracy.runtime_note: Full-dataset accuracy precedes helper extraction and a diagnostic text change. Final runtime retains the numerical path; operator regression tests pass and final benchmark outputs are bit-identical to the pre-refactor outputs on the same image.

ort_placement: Separate profiled run; all 83 ConvInteger nodes use CPUExecutionProvider. Only QuantizeLinear and DequantizeLinear are assigned to NeutronExecutionProvider.
